selection: Select highest nominal expected return among H/D/A, then filter that pick. Expected gross payout probability * decimal odds must strictly exceed 1 + min_edge; quoted odds bounds are inclusive. No replacement pick if the original fails. The return filter uses nominal probabilities; robust sizing then subtracts 0.02.
sizing: Quarter Kelly capped at 2% per match and 10% per day of opening bankroll. Flat $1 respects the same caps. Reserve all stakes before daily settlement.
limits: Frozen earlier chronological CV model choices; no retraining or threshold optimization. Previously inspected audit/test seasons. Historical Bet365 quotes, no costs or rounding. Each simulation independently starts at $1000; profits are not additive.
